content.short: SEDA is a multichain, permissionless decentralized oracle network that connects real-world data and events to on-chain smart contracts.
content.description: SEDA is a decentralized oracle network that brings real-world data onto the blockchain. Designed as a multichain, permissionless protocol, SEDA connects external data and events to any on-chain network, enabling smart contracts to react to verifiable information from the outside world. By providing trusted data feeds across multiple chains, SEDA supports diverse applications that rely on external inputs, from DeFi to automation, while maintaining a secure and transparent data delivery framework for developers and users.
